title: Introduction to Information Retrieval
author: Christopher Manning
description: Classic textbook on information retrieval, covering inverted indexes, ranking and evaluation of search engines.

title: Search Engines: Information Retrieval in Practice
author: Bruce Croft
description: A practical guide to building search engines, including crawling, indexing and query processing.

title: Apache Solr: A Practical Approach to Enterprise Search
author: Dikshant Shahi
description: Hands-on guide to Apache Solr covering schema design, indexing and faceted search.

title: Mining the Web: Discovering Knowledge from Hypertext Data
author: Soumen Chakrabarti
description: Foundations of web mining, hyperlink analysis and web structure analysis.

title: Web Data Mining: Exploring Hyperlinks, Contents and Usage Data
author: Bing Liu
description: Comprehensive introduction to web content mining, web structure mining and web usage mining.

title: Speech and Language Processing
author: Daniel Jurafsky
description: Widely used textbook on natural language processing, including text classification and information extraction.

title: Taming Text: How to Find, Organize and Manipulate It
author: Grant Ingersoll
description: Practical techniques for search, named entity recognition and text analytics using open source tools such as Lucene and Solr.

title: Database Systems: The Complete Book
author: Hector Garcia-Molina
description: Core database theory including storage, indexing, query processing and transactions.
